parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A single wheel of the cart made of rubber, typically attached to a metal caster base.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle and swivels for directional control.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second wheel of the cart made of rubber, providing stability and mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cart’s weight and enables rolling motion.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates and swivels to assist in steering and movement.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A third wheel of the cart, identical in function and material to the others.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to balanced support and smooth rolling.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates freely and swivels for maneuverability.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wheel of the cart, completing the four-wheel support system.
parts.Functional_description: It ensures stability and even load distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates and swivels to allow multidirectional movement.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main frame and shelves of the cart made of steel, providing structural integrity.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the load, provides surfaces for carrying items, and includes a handle for pushing or pulling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels but moves as a whole when the cart is pushed or pulled.
